patch_description: The previous candidate suffered from parameter bloat (62 parameters), which likely led to overfitting and lower test accuracy (0.88). The best-performing model used 26 parameters. This edit simplifies the ansatz significantly by removing the excessive "CRY" controlled gates and reducing the number of parameters per block to a more efficient, proven configuration (similar to the high-performing 26-parameter model). We retain the structure of the successful 0-3/4-7 bank split but remove the extra CRY gates to improve convergence and reduce parameter count.
